description: Last of the six Type 76 MiG-21PF inducted before the 1965 war; displayed on the ground outside the Officers' Mess of the School of Artillery, identified 2012 (warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak BC-827). Coordinates from warbirds.in.

Last of the first seven T.4 trainers, served to 2007 (last with 106 Sqn), retrieved from Agra salvage 2011 and displayed at Cadet Hill near the Army Public School, floodlit at night; original stencilling intact (warbirds.in 2014, photos Atamvir Multani; Bharat Rakshak IQ-999).

Auster V (c/n TAY 100A, built 1942) formerly at the IAF Museum, donated to the Artillery museum 1972, moved to the School of Artillery 1994, restored Sep 2013 and unveiled at the Heritage Mess "Guns through the Ages" park; all-green with perspex cowlings (warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak IN-959 gives ex TJ268). Visitable during the annual Topchi demonstration.
